language_mappings.indexes: Zero-based numeric lookup, negative indexes normalized; absent entries BoundsError extends RangeError, invalid index types InputTypeError extends TypeError.
language_mappings.measurements: Stored universal measurements map to exact EMUs/Length including centimeter/millimeter/point forms. Model null height rule preserves remaining height and inferred AT_LEAST; a cleared empty trHeight is removed.
language_mappings.ownership: Inherited part/element/table and public underscore collection owners remain public; consumed merge donor handles invalidate.
language_mappings.xml: Private XML helpers map to bounded admitted model or typed coordinate editor; original cases check exact observable XML ordering and preservation.
language_mappings.security: Whole-cell assignment affecting a nested table rejects before publication; no arbitrary method invocation or ambient filesystem access.

legal: Behavioral adaptation uses original wording/assets. Existing standalone upstream-license-notice.txt retains research attribution; product source/tests contain no reference-project identities.
qualification_policy: Passing original behavioral adaptation/explicit semantic disposition is recorded per row. Private helper replacement and explicit security differences do not claim unchanged native source workflow or whole-public-API parity.

execution.typecheck: No owned diagnostics; concurrent package diagnostics remain coordinator-owned at retained typecheck.log.
